summary: Lifezone Metals Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on May 5, 2026. The filing reports that ordinary resolutions were passed, including the receipt of accounts, ratification of the auditor, and re-election of directors Keith Liddell and Chris Showalter. 72% of ordinary shares were represented. This is routine shareholder meeting results with no special-situation event. No deal terms or structural changes are disclosed. No watch items; the filing is purely periodic.
